title: Android: get your Costco receipt as a PDF

vo.text: On Android? Save your Costco receipt as a PDF.
Tap Account, then Orders and Purchases.
Pick Online or warehouse. PriceBack reads both.
View the receipt, tap Print Receipt, choose Save as PDF, then Save.
In PriceBack, tap Upload file, and pick the PDF from Downloads.
On an iPhone? Use the Costco app, and watch our iPhone version.
